title: Weighted Sample Time Math
text: Support calculations involving sample time, 1 input, 1 output, direct feedthrough, {Operation} sets Math operation; {Weight value} sets the weight for sample time, {Implement using} sets the method for adjusting sample time Online, {Output data type} sets the data type of output signal, {Integer rounding mode} sets the rounding mode for fixed-point operations, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action, {Mode} sets the data type mode, {Signedness}, {Scaling} sets the method for scaling fixed-point data Best, {Word length} sets the bit size of word that holds quantized, {Fraction length}, {Slope} sets the slope for the fixed-point data, {Bias} sets the bias for the fixed-point data type and {Data type override}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Weight value
params.values: Weight for sample time 1.0 (default) | real-valued scalar

params.name: Implement using
params.values: Method for adjusting sample time Online Calculations (default) | Offline Scaling Adjustment

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Data type of output signal Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Inherit via back propagation | double | single | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 | int64 | uint64 | fixdt(1,16,0) | fixdt(1,16,2 0,0) |

params.name: Integer rounding mode
params.values: Rounding mode for fixed-point operations Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Method of overflow action off (default) | on

params.name: Mode
params.values: Data type mode Inherit (default) | Built in | Fixed point | Expression

params.name: Signedness
params.values: Signedness of fixed-point data Signed (default) | Unsigned

params.name: Scaling
params.values: Method for scaling fixed-point data Best precision (default) | Binary point

params.name: Word length
params.values: Bit size of word that holds quantized integer 16 (default) | integer from 2 to 128

params.name: Fraction length
params.values: Fraction length for fixed-point data type 0 (default) | integer scalar

params.name: Slope
params.values: Specify slope for the fixed-point data type 2^0 (default) | positive, real-valued scalar

params.name: Bias
params.values: Specify bias for the fixed-point data type 0 (default) | real-valued scalar

params.name: Data type override
params.values: Data type override mode Inherit (default) | Off
